voice.audition_text: That is not a lens. Watch the face inside that floating water sphere flip upside down - then stay, because every replay hides a different layer. Forty-two seconds of NASA footage. About eleven minutes of asking how that happened. A curved boundary between air and water bends light.

clips.text: That is not a lens. Watch the face inside that floating water sphere flip upside down - then stay, because every replay hides a different layer.
clips.note: Default / selected in the idea study. Pattern interrupt; 'not a lens' resolves honestly in Chapter 4.

clips.text: A sphere of water, a face, and one impossible-looking flip. In the next ten minutes we will watch the same 42 seconds eight times, and each time something new will make sense.
clips.note: Replay promise up front. No reach or shock claim.

clips.text: Why is that face upside down? The answer is inside the water - not the camera. Let's replay it slowly, then slower, then with the sound still on.
clips.note: Question-first; native audio mentioned in the hook itself.

clips.text: Now the flip. A curved boundary between air and water bends light. Light crossing that boundary is refracted, and the curved surface sends the rays into a reversed arrangement, so the picture arrives upside down. The same bending makes rainbows in raindrops. So the sphere is behaving like a small optical element - a liquid lens. That is why the opening line said it is not a lens: there is no glass, no manufactured optic. The water is doing the job. Freeze here, at twenty-three seconds, and watch it at half speed.
clips.note: Longest excerpt - pacing / pronunciation check for the core physics chapter (3:30-5:00).

guardrails: Generic synthetic narration only. No real-person voice clone, no astronaut voice imitation.
No time-stretch / speed change of the generated speech.

NASA native crew audio stays in the master; these previews are isolated narration files, NOT a replacement or a final mix [2](workspace://production/monarch-cam/replay_lab_ep01_v11/PHASE_A_SOURCE_AUDIT_V11.md) [5](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/qc_summary.json).
No music, SFX, procedural bed or audio substitution.
VO text never says 'according to NASA' and never implies NASA reviewed or approved the analysis [3](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/).
No 'official NASA', no insignia, no endorsement, no invented date/outcome/view claim.
AI-use toggle remains a human decision at upload time [4](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/14328491?hl=en).
Human listening, full-motion review, creative approval and legal review are all still pending [5](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/qc_summary.json).
blockers: 16:9 source: local master is 1080x1920 vertical; original 4K not present locally.
Render/QC toolchain (ffmpeg, ffprobe, numpy, bundled v10_deps) absent in this snapshot.
